tokens: "You are on a quest to reach the end of the haunted house, but beware of the ghosts and traps that await you!\n"
"In each round you will roll a die and move that many spaces.\n"
"The spaces you land on may have an event, a ghost, an item, or nothing at all.\n"
"You start with 0 points and you gain points for each space you reach.\n"
"However, if you land on a space with a ghost, you lose all your points and start over!\n"
"You can also collect items to help you along the way, but be careful not to trust them too much!\n"
"You were defeated by the ghost and have to start over!\n"
"You found some coins on the ground and gained 5 points!\n"
"You found a charm that will protect you from the next ghost encounter!\n"
"You found a secret passage that will allow you to skip the next round!\n"
"The ghosts were too scared to attack this round!\n"
"The charm protected you from the ghosts!\n"
"You used the secret passage to skip this round!\n"
"The ghosts attacked you and you have to start over!\n"
"You have a charm that will protect you from the next ghost encounter!\n"
"You have found a secret passage that will allow you to skip the next round!\n"
"You have reached the end of the haunted house and have defeated all the ghosts!\n"
"Thank you for playing the Haunted House Simulator!\n"
